baslik: One Faulty Sensor Kept Pushing the Nose Down

sahneler.metin: Minutes after take-off, a new Boeing 737 MAX dove into the Java Sea.
All one hundred eighty nine people aboard were killed.
A sensor measuring the wing's angle had failed.
Flight software trusted it and pushed the nose down.
The pilots pulled it back up, over and over.
Most pilots hadn't been told the system existed.
It was redesigned to use two sensors and act only once.

aciklama:
Lion Air 610 dove into the Java Sea minutes after take-off. The cause: MCAS repeatedly trimming the nose down based on a single erroneous sensor.
